title: Official Allowable Increase Rates
description: SF Rent Board rates checked 2026-11-11 and historical context.

rows.notes: Relevant to Unit 2 lease start; no banked amount inferred.

rows.label: Local formula
rows.value: 60% of Bay Area CPI-U increase; max 7%

rows.label: Temporary CPI methodology
rows.notes: Jan. 13, 2026 minutes adopted Version 1 temporary methodology.

rows.label: Calculation
rows.value: Base rent x rate; no rounding up

rows.label: Proposed banked and capital-improvement cap, File 261020
rows.value: Not enacted as of November 11, 2026; proposal would temporarily limit combined banked and capital-improvement increases to 10% per year.
rows.notes: If enacted as currently proposed, applicability would include banked notices and capital-improvement petitions from September 15, 2026. Check current status; see F46.

rows.label: Effect of proposed cap on either unit
rows.notes: Not enacted and case-specific histories are unverified; do not treat the proposal as current law.

rows.label: Legistar record checked 2026-11-11
rows.value: Version 1; introduced 9/15/2026; Pending Committee Action; final action and enactment date/number blank
rows.notes: Check current status before relying on a banked calculation.

rows.label: Proposed applicability date vs posting date
rows.value: Version 1 would apply to banked notices and capital-improvement petitions on or after September 15, 2026.
rows.notes: September 15 is the introduction date; the Rent Board notice was posted November 9. Not enacted.

rows.label: Proposed end date and excess
rows.value: Version 1 would remain in effect through December 31, 2029 unless extended; excess may be imposed from January 1, 2030 as otherwise permitted by law.
rows.notes: The title and a temporary notice alone do not establish a duration inconsistency. Not enacted.

rows.label: Next-year rate (3/1/27 - 2/28/28)
rows.notes: Still not published on either official page when re-checked 2026-11-11; blank rather than estimated.

rows.label: Proposed measurement of 10%
rows.value: Version 1 measures the combined banked/capital-improvement limit against 10% of the lowest base rent in the 12 months immediately before the increase.
rows.notes: Its interaction with an ordinary annual increase and case-specific application remain unverified; not enacted.
